title: A second thinking system
subtitle: A point of view, kept visible.
label: Editorial
summary: An authored sample essay about working with AI while keeping a point of view.

slides.title: A second thinking system
slides.claim: Working with AI without outsourcing a point of view. · FIELD NOTES / 01 · An essay in five parts

slides.title: Keep the question open.
slides.claim: A fast answer can close a thought too early. · What am I assuming? · What would change my mind? · The useful conversation begins with a better question. · FIELD NOTES / 02

slides.title: Collect. Connect. Challenge.
slides.claim: Collect · Keep the source close. · Connect · Put distant ideas in contact. · Challenge · Ask what the pattern leaves out. · Three moves for a thought worth keeping. · FIELD NOTES / 03

slides.title: Leave a trace of the thinking.
slides.claim: Source · What did I encounter? · Question · What does it unsettle? · Counterargument · What is the strongest objection? · Decision · What will I carry forward? · A small record makes a conversation reusable. · FIELD NOTES / 04

slides.title: The point of view is still yours.
slides.claim: Let the system widen the field. · Choose what deserves to remain. · A second thinking system. A first-person responsibility. · FIELD NOTES / 05

process.title: Start with a story
process.description: The outline sets out what each slide should communicate and how the essay develops across the deck.

process.title: Give the idea a visual form
process.description: The generated design guides the layout and appearance of the PowerPoint slide.

process.title: Name what should stay editable
process.description: The Agent identifies the slide’s text and illustrations before rebuilding them as separate objects.

process.title: Measure the visible evidence
process.description: OpenCV measures the visible content inside the regions identified by the Agent.

process.title: Construct the native objects
process.description: The PowerPoint combines editable text with separately placed artwork using the chosen fonts and measured positions.

process.title: Review the actual PowerPoint
process.description: This comparison shows the generated design beside the rendered PowerPoint slide.

process.title: Keep the series coherent
process.description: The Agent reviews the slides together and applies a consistent style to the recurring Field Notes label. This record documents those choices.
